summary_1line: Bhishma arranges royal marriages including Gandhari to blind Dhritarashtra, while Kunti receives a divine mantra and summons the Sun, conceiving Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Gandhari solemnly ties a cloth over her own eyes after learning her husband Dhritarashtra is blind.
Young Kunti stands in awe as the radiant Sun god appears before her in blazing light after she recites the sacred mantra.
The newborn Karna lies glowing with natural golden armor and earrings as divine light surrounds him.
